question: Thurgood (1999), second pass (the rime tables 56, 58, 62, 71, 82-88, Haroi register, Tsat tones): what is entered?
chosen_reading: Table 58 only: the reflexes of long *-u:- before *-ŋ and *-ʔ in Rade, Jarai, Chru, Northern Roglai, Tsat, Western Cham and Phan Rang Cham (17 rows), and Chru *-us > -u:h (1 row). Acehnese and (before *-ʔ) Tsat have '---'. The short-vowel rows of the table repeat Table 52 and are not entered again.
alternatives: 1. Table 56 (*-i-, p. 120) has no Proto-Chamic column: its rows are, by their order and reflexes, *-ih, *-im, *-iʔ, *-it, *-il, *-in, *-iŋ, *-ip. If that reading is accepted, new rows would be: Chru and Northern Roglai i: before ʔ (from *-iʔ and *-it), Chru i: before ŋ, Western Cham *-iŋ > -əŋ, and the upglide of *-ip > -iuʔ in Chru, Northern Roglai, Western Cham and Phan Rang Cham (-ĭwʔ). 2. Table 62 (*a by final, 24 rimes, p. 124), Table 71 (*ə), Tables 82-88 (*ɔ and the long vowels), the Haroi register splits (pp. 197ff., Tables 128-140) and the Tsat tones (Tables 145-154) were not read in this session.
